answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop fake identities. Each identity must post a heartbeat proof every epoch. The beacon samples agents at random; a chosen agent must answer within a horizon or lose its bond. Attackers cannot predict the sample, so even at their nadir they face the check. Faking a pigment trail for 100 identities costs 100 times the 5-credit fee, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its reward undiluted.
